query:
SELECT d.id, d.filename, d.status, d.`projectId`, t.`rawJson`
FROM documents d 
JOIN transcriptions t ON t.`documentId` = d.id
WHERE JSON_LENGTH(JSON_KEYS(t.`rawJson`)) > 4
LIMIT 2;

On the northern slope of the mountain, called Kubbet Bâbûttā, upon a spur of rock, stands the fine ruin of a pagan temple of Roman date, the first certainly classic building that we have found.
